canDo: Can write a complaint or request of ≥160 words with a clear purpose in 45 minutes.
review: Review past tenses, the conditionnel and politeness.
input: Analyse the task statement; don’t copy templates.
output: 10 minutes planning → 30 minutes writing → 5 minutes checking.
checkpoint: Self-check on five criteria: task completion, coherence, register, vocabulary, morphosyntax.
challenge: Today’s challenge: write a real complaint at DELF writing pace. Pick a small problem you ran into recently (a delivery, a takeaway order, a repair in your accommodation…): 10 minutes for an outline, 30 minutes to write a French complaint email of ≥160 words, 5 minutes to check it against the list; use at least 1 passive, 1 nominalisation (la livraison, le remboursement…) and 1 il faut que / je demande que + subjunctive.

questions.why: He thinks the problem only comes from two bikes that were abandoned long ago.
The length of the works stays the same; they just start and finish earlier.
